record.question: The rule of lapse in the Parliament means
options: All appropriations voted by the legislature expires at the end of the financial year.
All pending bills in Parliament lapse with its propagation.
The appropriation bill lapses if it is not returned by Rajya Sabha within 14 days.
The demand for grants of a ministry lapse with criticism of its policy by the opposition.
